title: Cognitive Fatigue, Runaway Loops, and the Verification Bottleneck
author_or_organization: Simon Willison, with Berkeley Haas and HBR Research
source_type: practitioner analysis and organizational field studies
limitations: Synthesizes field research on cognitive fatigue, context switching, and the shift of human effort from production to multi-threaded verification. Includes operational patterns for hard fiscal ceilings on autonomous agent spending; findings rely on qualitative surveys and practitioner trial records.
